summary: Iteration 13 - Blanco Editorial visual redesign regression. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest PASS. /api/activities returns 16 items each carrying both `emoji` (legacy) and new `icon` (lucide name) fields, and the icon values exactly match the SEED_ACTIVITIES map (Coffee, Mountain, Trees, Landmark, Clapperboard, UtensilsCrossed, Dumbbell, Volleyball, Flower2, BookOpen, Palette, Dice5, Dog, Music, MountainSnow, IceCreamCone). /api/auth/login, /api/discover (coords + email + hash NOT leaked; distance bucketed 5..50), /api/matches, /api/likes-received, /api/notifications/counts (shape + total = sum of the 3 counters), /api/profile/{id} (clean_public - no email/coords/hash), /api/admin/users (no coords leak) all unchanged. FRONTEND: All requested data-testids intact on Descubrir (mode-amistad, mode-amor, open-filters, me-tinca-btn, pass-btn, profile-comuna, profile-distance, bottom-nav, nav-*), Chats (tab-chats, tab-likes, like-armar-*, like-pasar-*, 3 like cards), Groups (tab-explorar, tab-mis, group-*, group-member-*), Perfil (necesito-apoyo-link, edit-profile-link, external-sinadicciones, perfil-terms, perfil-privacy, logout-btn, delete-account-btn), ChatDetail (chat-input types correctly, chat-send, propose-plan-btn, plan-status-bar, msg-system rendered as centered gray pill), EditProfile at /app/perfil/editar (edit-alias, edit-bio, save-profile, location-* x3, edit-mode-* x4), PublicProfile /app/usuario/:id (pp-alias, pp-block, pp-report-open), NecesitoApoyo (reason-input, reason-add, tel-salud/suicidio/urgencias, link-sinadicciones), Waitlist (waitlist-email, waitlist-submit), MisPlanes renders 'Próximos' + 'Pasados' with 'Confirmado' mint chips, BottomNav gradient bar on active tab. Note: `mode-apoyo` not present for demo1 because demo1's swipe_modes = [amistad, amor] (seed) - swipeModes filter is correct, this is by design and not a regression. `like-no-plan` and `profile-bio` are conditional (like-no-plan is inside the me-tinca picker modal; profile-bio only renders when the swiped profile has a bio string) - both verified via source. BOTTOMNAV chats-badge did not render for demo1 because unseen count was 0 at test time (already cleared during iteration 12 test). CRITICAL VISUAL VIOLATIONS FOUND: several UI-chrome strings (NOT user-generated content) still contain emoji characters, contradicting the 'zero emojis in UI' requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Buttons render {m.emoji} (line 113 EditProfile.jsx) - user sees 🫂 (Apoyo), 🙂 (Amistad), ❤️ (Amor), 👥 (Grupos). These are UI chrome (buttons/labels), not user-generated content. Should use Icon from lib/icons.jsx instead of MODES.emoji.
🇨🇱 flag emoji rendered inline at LocationPicker.jsx:73 (' Providencia 🇨🇱') and :97 (confirm state). Used in EditProfile and Onboarding step 2. This is UI chrome.
Onboarding.jsx:159 renders {m.emoji} for mode chips and :254 renders {a.emoji} for activity chips - UI chrome, should use lucide Icon.
EditProfile.jsx:145 renders {a.emoji} for activity chips - UI chrome.
PublicProfile.jsx:59 renders `{m.emoji} {m.l}` inside mode chip - UI chrome (unlike Profile.jsx:87 which correctly uses lucide Icon).
GroupDetail.jsx:79 renders {group.emoji} as the group avatar/badge - UI chrome. Groups list also renders group.emoji.
ChatDetail.jsx:269 renders `<option>{a.emoji} {a.name}</option>` in the propose-plan native select - UI chrome.
Waitlist.jsx:47 body text 'PlanSobrio nació en Chile 🇨🇱' - UI chrome copy.

Chats page renders backend system-message previews containing emoji (☕/🥾/🎉) e.g. '¡Están de acuerdo! ☕ Café y conversación...', '¡Plan confirmado! ☕ Café y conversación 🎉'. Source is server.py L941/L1101/L1352 which embed activity.emoji in the sys_text. This straddles the 'message content' fence. Per review rule ('emojis inside messages MAY still appear - that's fine') this is arguably acceptable, but flagging because these are system-generated (not user-generated) strings.

issues: Distance chip renders as ' · a ~5 km' - the ' · a ' prefix reads awkwardly in Spanish; consider ' · ~5 km' or ' a ~5 km' (drop the middot). Cosmetic, not blocking.

action_items: Replace `{m.emoji}` with `<Icon name=... />` in: EditProfile.jsx L113, Onboarding.jsx L159, PublicProfile.jsx L59 — map each MODES entry to a lucide icon (apoyo=HeartHandshake, amistad=Smile, amor=Heart, grupos=Users) as already done in BottomNav and Profile.

Replace activity emoji with new `icon` field from backend everywhere activities are picked/listed: EditProfile.jsx L145, Onboarding.jsx L254, ChatDetail.jsx L269 (propose-plan <select>). Activities now carry `icon` (lucide name) - use <Icon name={a.icon}/>.
Remove ' 🇨🇱' string in LocationPicker.jsx L73 and L97 (or replace with a lucide MapPin/Globe indicator). This propagates into Onboarding step 2 and EditProfile.
Replace group.emoji rendering in GroupDetail.jsx L79 (and Groups list card) with an Icon derived from group.emoji via emojiToIconName mapping in lib/icons.jsx.
Waitlist.jsx L47: remove 🇨🇱 flag from body copy or replace with a lucide Globe.

OPTIONAL - server.py L941/L1101/L1352 sys_text strings embed activity.emoji. If the design goal is truly zero-emoji in system-generated messages too, remove the emoji from these templates (leaving the activity name only). Otherwise leave as-is per the reviewer's allowance for message content.
critical_code_review_comments: EditProfile.jsx L113 + Onboarding L159 + PublicProfile L59 all still read `m.emoji` from MODES; the icon registry in lib/icons.jsx already contains the correct lucide keys (HeartHandshake, Smile, Heart, Users). A helper `modeIcon(v)` in constants/comunas.js would avoid the current per-file mapping (BottomNav.jsx and Profile.jsx already re-declare it inline as MODE_ICON). DRY.
LocationPicker.jsx L73/97 hardcode ' 🇨🇱' - inconsistent with the emoji-free design and also a country-symbol that will break the moment PlanSobrio expands beyond Chile.

ChatDetail.jsx propose-plan native <select> can't render a lucide icon in <option>. Recommend converting the picker to the same button-grid used in Chats.jsx (pick-act-*) or a shadcn Select with SelectItem children.
Discover.jsx distance formatting: `${' · a ~5 km'}` reads oddly. Consider adjusting the template to ' · ~{n} km'.

backend server.py: `sys_text` templates on L941/L1101/L1352 embed the activity emoji — inconsistent with an emoji-free UI. If UGC/system messages should stay clean, drop emoji from these templates. Not a regression per se (unchanged in this iteration) but worth aligning.

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all data-testids present; 8 emoji-in-UI-chrome violations flagged

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent replaces MODES.emoji / activity.emoji / group.emoji / 🇨🇱 usages with lucide Icons (via emojiToIconName + Icon component from /app/frontend/src/lib/icons.jsx), re-run the emoji-scan by loading Descubrir → EditProfile (/app/perfil/editar) → Onboarding → PublicProfile (/app/usuario/:id) → GroupDetail → ChatDetail propose-plan modal → Waitlist and searching for regex /[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}]/u across leaf DOM nodes NOT inside [data-testid='profile-bio' | 'msg-system' | 'profile-page-bio']. Also revalidate: backend GET /api/activities still returns `icon` for all 16 (already covered by test_iteration13_visual_regression.py::TestActivitiesIcon). Test file is idempotent and safe to re-run.
